description: What the user's Payouts page shows, read-only: lifetime and this month's earnings split into film sales and ad earnings, the balance (available to cash out, maturing inside the hold window (a pre-order stays maturing until its release, and its hold counts from the release), paid out, in flight), the payout minimum and hold period, the saved payout method in masked form, whether ad earnings are live for this account or still coming soon (with estimated creator earnings per 1,000 counted ad views after payment-processing fees), a per-film breakdown (sales, refunds, gross, net earnings) and the 5 most recent payouts. Amounts are in cents with a display string. Read-only: to cash out or change the payout method the user opens https://vidreno.com/payouts. Use list_payouts for the full payout history and list_film_sales for individual orders.
name: get_earnings
title: Earnings and balance
